description: This PHP class defines a validator for image dimension constraints in Drupal, resizing images that exceed specified maximum dimensions and validating minimum dimensions.

classes.name: FileImageDimensionsConstraintValidator
classes.description: Validator class for checking and resizing images based on dimension constraints in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting image factory and messenger services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the validator with services from the container.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the image file against max and min dimension constraints, resizing if necessary, and adds violation messages if constraints are not met.
